source: 12 frozen BedWars captures, consecutive client tick snapshots of remote players
comparison: shared regression plus causal player-specific residuals
shot_origin: counterfactual open-air shooter at target starting feet height and matched seeded bearings
score: native-sized hitbox intersection under matched arrow dispersion, plus held-out X/Z and Y forecast errors
observation_policy: remote positions from the shooter's client; no future or hidden observations enter prediction. Evaluation requires 42 consecutive recorded future ticks for both arms.
